title: Answer
description:
The oath was sworn after obedience, not instead of it. It is unchangeable because God is not a man who repents of what he has sworn.

Refuge lasts while the high priest lives, so a priest who does not die does not end the stay. The hope is already behind the veil, which is the place the blood was carried.

He is inside where they cannot yet crowd in, and He has gone first so that they cross after Him.
